answer.sql: WITH rec_latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv.facility_id) mv.facility_id, mv.score FROM hq.measure_values AS mv WHERE mv.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' ORDER BY mv.facility_id, mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, mv.id DESC) SELECT h.hospital_ownership AS ownership_type, COUNT(*) AS texas_hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(h.overall_rating) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating, m.measure_id, m.measure_name FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN rec_latest AS r ON r.facility_id = h.facility_id JOIN hq.measures AS m ON m.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership, m.measure_id, m.measure_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY AVG(r.score) DESC NULLS LAST, h.hospital_ownership LIMIT 200

answer.sql: WITH hospital_periods AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.period_start, mv.period_end FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = mv.facility_id WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE AND mv.measure_id = 'H_HSP_RATING_9_10' AND mv.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mv.facility_id, mv.period_start, mv.period_end), periods_per_hospital AS (SELECT facility_id, COUNT(*) AS period_count FROM hospital_periods GROUP BY facility_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS texas_hospitals_with_score, MAX(period_count) AS largest_reporting_period_count, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE period_count > 1) AS hospitals_with_multiple_periods FROM periods_per_hospital LIMIT 200

h.readm_score) / NULLIF(s.readm_sd, 0) + (h.recommend_score - s.recommend_avg) / NULLIF(s.recommend_sd, 0) + (h.sepsis_score - s.sepsis_avg) / NULLIF(s.sepsis_sd, 0)) / 3, 2) AS composite FROM hospital_scores AS h CROSS JOIN measure_stats AS s), ranked AS (SELECT facility_name, county, composite, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite DESC, facility_name, county) AS high_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY composite ASC, facility_name, county) AS low_rank FROM composites), selected AS (SELECT 'Top 10' AS group_label, facility_name, county, composite, 1 AS group_order FROM ranked WHERE high_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'Bottom 10' AS group_label, facility_name, county, composite, 2 AS group_order FROM ranked WHERE low_rank <= 10) SELECT group_label, facility_name, county, composite FROM selected ORDER BY group_order, CASE WHEN group_order = 1 THEN composite END DESC, CASE WHEN group_order = 2 THEN composite END ASC, facility_name, county LIMIT 200

Return measure ID, the national average (2 decimals), Texas hospitals with a score, how many beat the national average and the share in percent (1 decimal), highest share first, ties by measure ID.

answer.question: For six measures, what share of Texas hospitals do better than the national average (average over all U.S. hospitals with a score)? Measures: 30-day pneumonia readmission rate, 30-day heart failure death rate, central-line infection ratio (lower is better for these three), sepsis care percentage, 'would definitely recommend' percentage and HCAHPS summary star rating (higher is better for these three). Return measure ID, the national average (2 decimals), Texas hospitals with a score, how many beat the national average and the share in percent (1 decimal), highest share first, ties by measure ID.
answer.answer: HAI_1_SIR: national average 0.58; 151 Texas hospitals had a score, 99 beat the average (65.6%). MORT_30_HF: 11.07; 206 hospitals had a score, 132 beat it (64.1%). SEP_1: 63.79; 233 hospitals had a score, 146 beat it (62.7%). READM_30_PN: 17.34; 258 hospitals had a score, 150 beat it (58.1%). H_RECMND_DY: 71.22; 297 hospitals had a score, 158 beat it (53.2%). H_STAR_RATING: 3.27; 229 hospitals had a score, 92 beat it (40.2%).
answer.sql: WITH wanted AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('READM_30_PN', FALSE), ('MORT_30_HF', FALSE), ('HAI_1_SIR', FALSE), ('SEP_1', TRUE), ('H_RECMND_DY', TRUE), ('H_STAR_RATING', TRUE)) AS w(measure_id, higher_is_better)), ranked AS (SELECT mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id, mv.score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mv.facility_id, mv.measure_id ORDER BY mv.period_end DESC NULLS LAST) AS period_rank FROM hq.measure_values AS mv JOIN wanted AS w ON w.measure_id = mv.measure_id), latest AS (SELECT r.facility_id, r.measure_id, r.score FROM ranked AS r WHERE r.period_rank = 1 AND r.score IS NOT NULL), national AS (SELECT l.measure_id, AVG(l.score) AS national_avg FROM latest AS l GROUP BY l.measure_id), texas AS (SELECT l.measure_id, COUNT(*) AS tx_hospitals_with_score, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (w.higher_is_better AND l.score > n.national_avg) OR (NOT w.higher_is_better AND l.score < n.national_avg)) AS tx_beating_national FROM latest AS l JOIN hq.hospitals AS h ON h.facility_id = l.facility_id JOIN wanted AS w ON w.measure_id = l.measure_id JOIN national AS n ON n.measure_id = l.measure_id WHERE h.is_texas GROUP BY l.measure_id) SELECT w.measure_id, m.measure_name, ROUND(n.national_avg, 2) AS national_average, t.tx_hospitals_with_score, t.tx_beating_national, ROUND(100.0 * t.tx_beating_national / NULLIF(t.tx_hospitals_with_score, 0), 1) AS share_percent FROM wanted AS w JOIN hq.measures AS m ON m.measure_id = w.measure_id JOIN national AS n ON n.measure_id = w.measure_id JOIN texas AS t ON t.measure_id = w.measure_id ORDER BY CAST(t.tx_beating_national AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(t.tx_hospitals_with_score, 0) DESC, w.measure_id LIMIT 200
